$comment: Verif-Kit per-project config. Copy to repo root as verif-kit.config.json and edit. This is the ONE place project specifics live, so the agent/skill prompts stay generic and portable (mirrors spec-kit's init-options.json). All paths are repo-root-relative.

framework.frameworkDir: node_modules-or-vendored path to verif-kit framework (scoreboard, coverage-model)

commands.$comment: How to run things in THIS repo. The agent/skill call these instead of hard-coding. On Windows where the toolchain is not on the non-interactive PATH, prefix accordingly.

riskTiers.$comment: Per-tier gates the EXECUTE/sign-off pass enforces.

security.$comment: Enable the cyber-engineer lens for modules touching auth, multi-user data, or untrusted input.

onlineResearch.$comment: Allow the verifier to research DOMAIN corner cases online. It must NEVER search for or read the implementation under test.
onlineResearch.scope: domain edge cases, standards, known-tricky inputs — never the implementation

independence.$comment: b = in-session fresh subagent (default); c = separate cloud session (strongest, reserve for P0/evidence).
